description: Source code for the ForegroundDispatch activity demonstrating NFC foreground dispatch APIs in an Android application.

classes.name: ForegroundDispatch
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating NFC foreground dispatch API usage, allowing the app to intercept NFC tags when active.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI elements, NFC adapter, intent filter for NDEF discovery, and tech list for NfcF tags.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Enables foreground dispatch when the activity resumes.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new NFC tag discovery intents, updating the UI with information about the detected tag.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Disables foreground dispatch when the activity is paused.
